layout.body: This is to let all employees know that the staff meeting scheduled for Wednesday, August 10th at 2:00 PM has been rescheduled. The meeting will now take place on Friday, August 12th at 3:00 PM in the main conference room. Please be on time. Thank you.

questions.stem: What is the main purpose of the notice?

options.A: To introduce new employees to staff
options.B: To announce a change in a meeting schedule
options.C: To apologize for a scheduling conflict
options.D: To inform employees of a conference opportunity

questions.analysis: What is the main purpose of the notice? nguyên văn dựa vào: the staff meeting... has been rescheduled A: hướng nhân viên giới thiệu viết tắt của Tân Cương nhân viên → Sai B: tuyên bố cuộc họp thời gian thay đổi → Đúng C: về mặt thời gian giữa xung đột xin lỗi → Sai D: báo tin nhân viên cuộc họp cơ hội → Sai

questions.stem: When will the staff meeting take place?
questions.analysis: When will the staff meeting take place? nguyên văn dựa vào: now take place on Friday, August 12th at 3:00 PM A: Wednesday, August 10th at 2:00 PM → Sai B: Wednesday, August 10th at 3:00 PM → Sai C: Friday, August 12th at 2:00 PM → Sai D: Friday, August 12th at 3:00 PM → Đúng
